meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 把你在 NanoClaw 分支里做的自定义改动（改配置、改源码、改人设、加技能）提取成一份可重放的迁移指南，升级上游时在干净的 worktree 上按指南重新应用一遍。全程不走 git merge，因此不会产生合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你 fork 了 NanoClaw 并做过自定义，又想让上游更新或重构后仍保留这些改动时会用到。已有迁移指南时，可以直接跳到升级阶段。

say.text: 帮我从我的 NanoClaw 分支提取一份迁移指南
say.note: 先做预检，评估改动范围再确定方案

say.text: 用现有迁移指南把我的自定义升级到最新上游
say.note: 在 worktree 里验证后再动本地安装

say.text: 只更新现有迁移指南，把新增改动补进去
say.note: 分析自上次生成以来的提交并追加

howto.what_en: Extracts your NanoClaw fork customizations into a replayable migration guide, then upgrades to upstream by reapplying them on a clean worktree — no git merge, so no merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Use when your NanoClaw fork has customizations (config, source, personas, skills) and upstream shipped updates you want to keep them through. If a guide already exists, it can skip straight to the upgrade phase.

say_en.text: Extract a migration guide from my NanoClaw fork
say_en.note: Runs preflight and assesses the change scope first

say_en.text: Upgrade my customizations to latest upstream with the existing guide
say_en.note: Validates in a worktree before touching the live install

say_en.text: Just update the existing guide with my new changes
say_en.note: Analyzes commits since the guide was generated and appends them
